items.source: In contrast to synchronizations, the transaction execution listener contract is commonly supported for thread-bound transactions as well as reactive transactions. The callback-provided TransactionExecution object will be either a TransactionStatus (for a PlatformTransactionManager transaction) or a ReactiveTransaction (for a ReactiveTransactionManager transaction).
items.translation: 与同步操作不同，事务执行监听器合约通常也支持线程绑定事务以及响应式事务。回调提供的TransactionExecution对象将是一个TransactionStatus（用于PlatformTransactionManager事务）或一个ReactiveTransaction（用于ReactiveTransactionManager事务）。

items.source: Callback after the transaction begin step.
items.translation: 事务开始步骤之后的回调。

items.source: Callback after the transaction commit step.
items.translation: 事务提交步骤之后的回调。

items.source: beginFailure - an exception occurring during begin (or null after a successful begin step)
items.translation: beginFailure - 在开始期间发生的异常（或在成功执行开始步骤后为 null）

items.source: commitFailure - an exception occurring during commit (or null after a successful commit step)
items.translation: commitFailure - 提交期间发生的异常（或在成功提交步骤后为 null）

items.source: rollbackFailure - an exception occurring during rollback (or null after a successful rollback step)
items.translation: rollbackFailure - 回滚期间发生的异常（或在成功回滚步骤后为 null）
